licoes.objectivo: Comparar duas opções com comparativos, much / a bit, less e (not) as … as.

exercicios.frase: Model B is [much] cheaper — two million kwanzas less.
It's a bit [noisier] than Model A.
Model A uses [less] fuel.
Model B is as powerful [as] Model A.

exercicios.enunciado: "Model B isn't as good as Model A" means...

opcoes.texto: This laptop is much better than the old one.
This laptop is very better than the old one.
This laptop is more better than the old one.
The new office isn't as big as the old one.
The new office isn't as big than the old one.
The new office isn't so big like the old one.

exercicios.frase: Yes, it's as powerful as Model A. But it's a bit noisier, and it's heavier.
exercicios.enunciado: What is the problem with Model B?

exercicios.frase: Model B is much cheaper, but it isn't as good as Model A.

exercicios.enunciado: Compare your phone with a colleague's phone.
exercicios.frase: as
exercicios.resposta: My phone is much cheaper than my colleague's phone, but the camera isn't as good. The battery is a bit better.
exercicios.contexto: Use much, a bit e (not) as … as.

exercicios.enunciado: Compare two places to have lunch near your work.
exercicios.frase: than
exercicios.resposta: The café is much cheaper than the restaurant, but it's a bit noisier. The food isn't as good as at the restaurant.

licoes.objectivo: Escolher e recomendar o melhor de um grupo com superlativos, in e of.

exercicios.frase: For me, the [most beautiful] place is the Miradouro da Lua.
Mussulo is the most crowded beach [in] Luanda on Sundays.
Benfica is the cheapest [of] the three markets.
The traffic is the [worst] thing about Luanda.

opcoes.texto: It's one of the oldest buildings in the city.
It's one of the oldest building in the city.
It's one of the older buildings of the city.
What's the best place to visit in Luanda?
What's the better place to visit in Luanda?
What's the most good place to visit in Luanda?

exercicios.enunciado: "A praia mais cheia de Luanda" em inglês é...

opcoes.texto: the most crowded beach in Luanda
the most crowded beach of Luanda
the more crowded beach in Luanda

exercicios.frase: Mussulo. But on Sundays it's the most crowded beach in Luanda! Go on Saturday morning.
exercicios.enunciado: When is the best time to go to Mussulo?

exercicios.frase: It's the oldest building in the city. It's the best view near Luanda.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: the oldest /ði/, the best /ðə/.
What's the best restaurant in your city, and why?
exercicios.frase: the best
exercicios.resposta: The best restaurant in my city is a small place near the beach. The fish is the freshest in town, and it isn't the most expensive.
exercicios.contexto: Use the best e mais um superlativo.

exercicios.enunciado: A visitor asks: "What's the most beautiful place in Angola?" Recommend a place.
exercicios.frase: I recommend
exercicios.resposta: I recommend the Kalandula Falls. They're the most beautiful falls in Angola, and one of the biggest in Africa.

licoes.titulo: How much time do we have?
licoes.objectivo: Falar de quantidades com much, many, a lot of, a few e a little, e usar a / the / sem artigo.

exercicios.frase: How [many] cables do we have?
We don't have [much] time.
We only have [a few] plugs.
There's [a little] money for small things.

opcoes.texto: The new equipment arrived on Friday.
The new equipments arrived on Friday.
The new equipments arrives on Friday.
She gave me some good advice.
She gave me some good advices.
She gave me a good advices.

exercicios.enunciado: "Os cabos são caros" (em geral). Em inglês:

exercicios.frase: A lot of cables — about two hundred. But we only have a few plugs. Maybe thirty.
exercicios.enunciado: How many plugs do they have?

exercicios.frase: We have a lot of cables, but only a few plugs. There's a little money left.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "a lot of" ligado.
How much free time do you have this week?
exercicios.frase: much
exercicios.resposta: I don't have much free time this week. I have a little time on Sunday afternoon.

exercicios.enunciado: How many emails do you get every day, and how many meetings do you have?
exercicios.frase: a lot of
exercicios.resposta: I get a lot of emails — about fifty a day. But I only have a few meetings, maybe two or three.
exercicios.contexto: Use a lot of, many ou a few.

licoes.objectivo: Usar as palavras de um orçamento; /ə/ fraco; costume e exquisite.

exercicios.enunciado: What's more important for you: the cheapest price or good value? Why?
exercicios.frase: good value
exercicios.resposta: For me, good value is more important. The cheapest product isn't always reliable.
exercicios.contexto: Dê a sua opinião e uma razão.

exercicios.enunciado: Describe a quote: price, discount, delivery time and warranty.
exercicios.frase: warranty
exercicios.resposta: The total price is two million kwanzas, with a discount of ten per cent. The delivery time is one week, and the warranty is one year.

licoes.titulo: Real English: Which one is better?
licoes.objectivo: Identificar a opção que cada pessoa escolhe e as razões, em três conversas.

exercicios.frase: I don't take many photos. I need a good battery — I work nights at the hospital.

opcoes.texto: She works nights at the hospital.
She takes a lot of photos.

I saved a lot of money, so I bought a new oven too!

exercicios.frase: The people are friendly in both cities. But the beaches… Luanda is much better.

Compare two cities in Angola. Which one is better for you, and why?
exercicios.frase: better
exercicios.resposta: Benguela is smaller than Luanda, and it's much quieter. The traffic isn't as bad. For me, Benguela is better for a holiday, but Luanda is better for work.

exercicios.enunciado: Which is better for you: a big car or a small car? Why?
exercicios.frase: cheaper
exercicios.resposta: A small car is better for me. It's cheaper, it uses less fuel, and parking is much easier in Luanda.

licoes.objectivo: Comparar dois orçamentos e recomendar um, com duas razões e uma desvantagem.

exercicios.frase: It's a bit more expensive, but it's [within] budget.
The only [disadvantage] is the price.

exercicios.enunciado: Which is the best order for a recommendation?
PowerSafe: 2 weeks, 2-year warranty, 3 420 000 Kz. Luanda UPS: 6 weeks, 1-year warranty, 3 100 000 Kz. Which sentence is true?

opcoes.texto: PowerSafe is a bit more expensive, but the delivery is much faster.
Luanda UPS is more expensive and slower.

opcoes.texto: The delivery time is six weeks, and the warranty is one year.
The delivery is in twelve months, and the warranty is six weeks.
Prazo de entrega is six weeks.

exercicios.frase: The only disadvantage is the price. But for Mussulo Energy, reliable service is more important than the cheapest price.
exercicios.enunciado: What is more important for Mussulo Energy, says Nuno?

exercicios.frase: The installation starts on the seventh of December, so six weeks is very late for us.
advantage, disadvantage, recommendation
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: adVANtage, disadVANtage, recommenDAtion.
NetRápida: 95 000 Kz a month, installation in 3 days, help 24 hours. KiandaNet: 70 000 Kz a month, installation in 3 weeks, help only in the day. Which do you recommend?
exercicios.frase: I recommend
exercicios.resposta: I recommend NetRápida. It's more expensive, but it's within budget. First, the installation is much faster. Also, the help is 24 hours. For us, good service is more important than the price.

exercicios.frase: disadvantage
exercicios.resposta: The only disadvantage is the price. It's about twenty-five thousand kwanzas more every month.
